skill_feedback: dbx_guard resolves only a single string literal in execute() or a NAME = triple-quoted-literal assignment; open().read(), argv paths, adjacent literals and concatenation are opaque blocks, so static .sql files must be embedded as literals by a generated runner script.

Shell-expanded DSN assignments (VAR="...$TOKEN") block as 'shell expansion inside the SQL argument'; the Lakebase OAuth credential must be minted inside Python and exported via os.environ before exec'ing `python3 -m recon.cli`.

recon `shape --out` writes the shape JSON at the path itself (a file); rerun-proof's --fresh record wraps it as {run,status,evidence,shape} and --source/--rerun-source must name the same committed job files both times.

--capabilities is rejected for --target-kind lakebase (no own-principal carve-out), and `python3 -m recon.cli` needs PYTHONPATH=<harness> with cwd=repo root for .migration/allowed_targets.json to resolve.
